## Checklist

- [ ] **Title summarises the change** (not "Fix #12")
- [ ] **PR covers one responsibility**; no unrelated lines touched
- [ ] **All tests pass locally**: `black --check .`, `flake8 .`, `mypy .`, `pytest`
- [ ] **Bug fix includes a non-regression test** that fails before the fix
- [ ] **Public functions have numpydoc docstrings**
- [ ] **Reads like the surrounding code**: comment density, naming and idiom
      match the existing modules; no step-by-step or obvious comments
- [ ] Coverage is at least 80% for the changed files
- [ ] No new `# type: ignore` without a justification comment
- [ ] New dependency (if any) is justified in one sentence
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if the change is user-visible
- [ ] **AI assistance: yes / no** — if yes, one sentence on its role, and the
      author confirms every line was reviewed and can be explained
